name: Traditional Vanilla Caramel Flan / Egg Custard
whyItWorks: Baked egg, milk, and caramel sugar custard. Silky smooth, requiring zero mechanical chewing and melting into liquid. Free from nuts, seeds, and chocolate.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A wonderful restaurant or home dessert. Take a lactase enzyme tablet for the condensed/evaporated milk base.
watchOuts: Contains dairy milk and eggs; take lactase if sensitive.
